title: Epic Business Rules
description: One business-rules.json lives in each Epic folder (.claude/architecture/<EPIC>/business-rules.json). It is the structured, machine-readable projection of the Business Rules table in suggestion.md, enriched with dependency edges and cross-artifact 'touches' anchors. Regenerated by /epic-generate (the br-synthesizer agent); a single new rule may also be appended by /br-add. The Business Rule is the atomic unit of spec; an Epic groups the BRs it owns. Node (x,y) coordinates are NOT stored here — the viewer keeps those in an app-owned br-positions.json so regeneration never clobbers hand-adjusted layout.

epic.description: The Epic that owns this file, e.g. EPIC-009.

title.description: Human title of the Epic (mirrors epics.md).

generated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the file was generated.

rules.description: Every Business Rule this Epic owns.

id.description: Globally unique Business Rule id, e.g. BR-054. The Business Rule is the atomic spec unit.

epic.description: Owning Epic. Drives vertical placement in the dependency net (earliest = highest).

seq.description: Global development order (numeric part of the id). Ties break vertical ordering within an Epic.

rule.description: The rule statement / specification — the exact text from the suggestion.md Business Rules table.

rationale.description: Optional longer explanation of WHY the rule exists (design intent, edge cases).

category.description: Optional coarse classification, used for node coloring / filtering.

dependsOn.description: Ids of Business Rules that are HARD PREREQUISITES of this rule (the edges of the dependency net). A rule depends on another when it cannot hold or be tested unless the other already holds — e.g. a role-check rule depends on the rule that introduced that role. Do NOT list merely thematically-related rules here; keep the graph a true prerequisite DAG.

relatedEpic.description: Epics referenced by this rule (from [[EPIC-XXX]] wiki-links in the source).

touches.description: Anchors into the other architecture artifacts. These are the join keys the viewer uses to cross-highlight the relevant sections of each existing view when this BR is selected.

entities.description: Backend entity / table / class names this rule governs (match nodes in ClassDiagram.md).

slices.description: NgRx feature slice names this rule affects (match FrontendState.md).

mockups.description: Mockup html filenames under <EPIC>/mockups/ that visualise this rule.

tests.description: Test-case identifiers / descriptions from testState.md that verify this rule (the rule's test-case library).
